children.title: Cycle 17 · Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and Mechanical Constraints

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and Mechanical Constraints
detail.summary: This research cycle investigates the structural requirements for establishing cross-turn state continuity and accountability in autonomous AI processes. Using collected source evidence, we analyze how mechanical constraints and durable state frameworks can bridge the gap between fresh model invocations to maintain coherent, verifiable entity behavior.
